scope: Authored proposals only; no shared deep-dive/topic/generator edit.

comparison.position: 先由reference-conditioned冻结M0构造中间M1，再冻结M1并移除reference，向从M0精确恢复、使用新optimizer的学生做teacher→student FKL。
comparison.tradeoff: 不同于持续特权视图OPSD，reset的是学生与optimizer，教师则保留已学参数；本地仅真实FKL/handoff，不含LM rollout或原文未可审核的pointwise clipping。空作者仓库不记为已开源实现。

analysis.title: 先构造可无参考使用的教师，与始终依赖特权视图是不同路径
analysis.body: OPSD让教师额外读取验证解，学生只见自身前缀；BOPD先把这种监督写入中间参数，再让无参考中间教师指导从初始checkpoint恢复的新学生。它不是把Stage I末尾学生继续训练，也不能把Stage I特权分数缓存成Stage II无参考监督。权重冻结不意味着在新学生前缀上预测恒定，必须保留阶段、上下文与参数状态三条来源。

question.question: 把OPSD的teacher去掉reference，再继续原学生，等于BOPD吗？
question.answer: 不等于。BOPD的Stage II教师来自Stage I学得的中间模型，而学生精确恢复初始模型并新建optimizer；去reference只是其中一条条件变化。继续原学生或换回初始teacher都改变了方法。
question.example: 教学例：Stage I把权重1学到1.2。Stage II teacher用1.2、student用1、optimizer空状态；两者都用1.2只是继续训练，不是该handoff。

update.summary: 补审BOPD，区分持续特权视图与两阶段无参考教师迁移，保留学生/optimizer重置及逐轨迹FKL；本地A100只验收loss/handoff，完整多GPU与长生成实验不复现。

comparison.position: Construct M1 using a reference-conditioned frozen M0, then freeze M1, remove references and distill by teacher-to-student FKL into a student exactly restored from M0 with a fresh optimizer.
comparison.tradeoff: Unlike continued privileged-view OPSD, the student and optimizer reset while the teacher retains learned parameters. Local coverage is actual FKL/handoff, not LM rollouts or unaudited source pointwise clipping. An empty author repository is not a released implementation.

analysis.title: Constructing a reference-free teacher differs from permanently relying on a privileged view
analysis.body: OPSD gives the teacher a verified solution while the student sees its own prefixes. BOPD first internalizes that supervision in intermediate parameters, then uses the reference-free intermediate to teach a student restored from its initial checkpoint. It is not continued Stage I student training, and privileged Stage I scores cannot become reference-free Stage II supervision by caching. Frozen weights can still predict differently on new student prefixes; stage, context and parameter provenance remain separate.

question.question: Does removing the reference from an OPSD teacher and continuing the student implement BOPD?
question.answer: No. Stage II uses the trained intermediate as teacher but restores the student exactly to the initial model and creates a new optimizer. Removing the reference is only one change; continuing the existing student or reverting the teacher changes the method.
question.example: A weight learned from 1 to 1.2 in Stage I remains 1.2 in the Stage II teacher, while the student returns to 1 with empty optimizer state. Starting both at 1.2 is continuation, not this handoff.

english.update: Added BOPD to distinguish continued privileged views from two-stage reference-free transfer, preserving student/optimizer restoration and per-trajectory FKL. A100 evidence covers loss/handoff only; full multi-GPU, long-generation experiments are not reproduced.

comparison.position: 每轮把KL reference更新为最新策略，再近似求解reference×exp(eta×reward)的镜像目标；有限核检查精确重置路径、Kimi均值baseline的平方KL偏差与Rebel=2×centered-MSE。
comparison.tradeoff: 参考重置不等于刷新PPO/GRPO old policy，也不等于把学生退回base；保证依赖策略/reward可实现性及内层精度。纯理论无大型实证方案，不编高成本或把数值检查当完整证明。

analysis.title: old policy负责采样比，KL reference决定优化锚点，二者不能混称旧模型
analysis.body: GRPO用old-policy ratio和组优势形成更新，同时另有reference KL；APMD讨论的是KL锚点随外层迭代重置，允许在强局部约束下累积前进。刷新采样行为的old policy不自动满足APMD的reference条件，组内去均值也不消除Kimi均值baseline相对镜像目标的平方KL偏差。这里的有限响应恒等式不能替代真实LLM的假设核验或采样误差分析。

question.question: GRPO已经周期更新old policy，为什么还不能说实现了APMD reference reset？
question.answer: old policy在概率比分母中记录行为分布；KL reference是正则化锚点。两者可不同步，且APMD还要求近似解满足内层误差条件，不能因名字都叫旧模型就认为等价。
question.example: 教学例：每批采样前刷新old policy，但KL始终惩罚偏离最初base，仍是固定reference；APMD下一轮锚定最新pi_t。

update.summary: 补审coverage/reference-reset理论，分清行为old policy、KL reference和student初始化；增加Kimi偏差与Rebel中心化恒等式。仅CPU精确有限核，纯理论大型实证不适用，不宣称普适GRPO收敛。

comparison.position: Reset the KL reference to the latest policy and approximate its reference-times-exponential-reward mirror target. Finite kernels check exact reset paths, Kimi's squared-KL mean-baseline bias and Rebel equals twice centered-MSE.
comparison.tradeoff: A reference reset is neither an old-policy refresh nor restoring the learner to the base. Guarantees require realizability and accurate inner solves. The theory has no large empirical protocol; cost is not invented and numerical checks are not a complete proof.

analysis.title: The old policy controls sampling ratios; the KL reference sets the optimization anchor
analysis.body: GRPO uses old-policy ratios and group advantages, alongside a separate reference KL. APMD resets that KL anchor across outer iterations, accumulating progress under strong local constraints. Refreshing the sampling old policy does not establish APMD's reference condition. Group centering also does not remove Kimi's squared-KL mean-baseline bias relative to the mirror target. Finite identities cannot replace realizability checks or sampling-error analysis for real LLMs.

question.question: Why does periodically refreshing GRPO's old policy not establish APMD reference resets?
question.answer: The old policy records behavior probabilities in a ratio denominator; the KL reference is a regularization anchor. They may update separately. APMD also requires an inner-approximation condition, so calling both old models does not make them equivalent.
question.example: Refresh the old policy before each sampled batch but keep penalizing KL to the original base: that reference is still fixed. APMD instead anchors the next outer round at the latest pi_t.

english.update: Added coverage/reference-reset theory to separate behavior old policies, KL anchors and learner initialization, with Kimi bias and Rebel centering identities. CPU finite references only; large empirical reproduction is not applicable, and universal practical-GRPO convergence is not claimed.

comparison.position: 按同任务完整动作LCS选最兼容成功reference，free-target OT独立argmax且允许复用；只更新失败episode，无引用时reference-free，ALFWorld/tau3分别使用不同归一化。
comparison.tradeoff: 不同于SPOD只在成功episode内保护teacher较不支持的action，这里整条成功轨迹不更新。LCS状态解释需要可恢复绕行，不是潜状态等价；本地没有Agent/OPD trainer，4500A100小时完整矩阵不复现。

analysis.title: 保护成功episode与保护成功里的特定action，更新集合不一样
analysis.body: LCS reference方法先排除全部成功学生episode，再为失败者选同任务引用并校正；SPOD仍可训练成功episode，只对teacher完整action概率低于student的decision取消KL并加软floor。前者还改变reference信息来源，后者改变action级监督。不能把二者统称success mask后混用分母、概率条件和更新门控，且训练用成功reference都不应暴露给被评估学生。

question.question: LCS failure-only和SPOD都保护成功，为什么不能复用同一个success mask？
question.answer: LCS跳过整个成功episode；SPOD还比较teacher/student的完整action概率，只保护满足条件的decision，其他位置继续蒸馏。因此mask粒度、归约和保留的loss都不同。
question.example: 教学例：一条成功episode中teacher对某动作比student更支持，SPOD可继续该动作KL；LCS方法仍跳过整条成功轨迹。

update.summary: 补审LCS同任务引用选择，区分整episode失败过滤与SPOD完整action保护；保留free-target独立选择、双normalizer和teacher-only reference。仅CPU选择核，不用fixture冒充多轮Agent训练。

comparison.position: Select the most compatible same-task success by complete-action LCS, with reusable independent free-target assignments. Update failed episodes only and fall back to reference-free supervision, preserving distinct ALFWorld/tau3 normalizers.
comparison.tradeoff: Unlike SPOD's conditional action protection inside successful episodes, this method skips all successful episodes. LCS requires recoverable-detour assumptions, not hidden-state equivalence. No agent/OPD trainer is included; the 4500-A100-hour matrix is not reproduced.

analysis.title: Protecting successful episodes and particular actions within them creates different update sets
analysis.body: The LCS method excludes every successful student episode and chooses same-task corrective references for failures. SPOD can still train successful episodes, suppressing KL and adding a soft floor only where the teacher's complete-action probability is below the student's. The former also changes reference information; the latter changes action-level supervision. A generic success mask cannot replace their distinct denominators, probability conditions and gates. Training success references remain hidden from evaluated students.

question.question: Why cannot LCS failure-only updates and SPOD share one success mask?
question.answer: LCS skips entire successful episodes. SPOD additionally compares complete-action teacher/student probabilities and protects only qualifying decisions, retaining distillation elsewhere. Mask granularity, reduction and retained losses differ.
question.example: When the teacher supports an action more than the student in a successful episode, SPOD can continue that action's KL. The LCS method still skips the entire successful trajectory.

english.update: Added same-task LCS selection, separating episode-level failure filtering from SPOD's complete-action protection. Preserved independent free-target assignment, both normalizers and teacher-only references. The CPU selector is not substitute multi-turn agent training.
